marks.gloss_en: the baraita: the incoming divide in the north, so that it be seen that they are incoming
ונימא ליה דל בדל! -- let [the outgoing watch] say to it: forgo [yours now] for [my] forgoing [later]
בוצינא טבא מקרא -- a cucumber now is better than a gourd later (= p_abaye_butzina)
R' Yitzchak: these two [extra loaves of the incoming watch] are as payment for closing the doors
מיתיבי: ...ואילו מוספין חולקין לא קתני -- the baraita assigns the musafin to the outgoing watch and does not teach that they divide
האי תנא בחלוקה לא קא מיירי (= p_lo_mairi_bachaluka)
Rav Yehuda: and in the musafin [the two watches] divide
והא תנא דבי שמואל, דמיירי בחלוקה, ובמוספין חולקין לא קתני? -- the school of Shmuel does speak of division and still does not teach it (this undercuts the answer to obj_meitivi_musafin; see header)

the school of Shmuel: the outgoing watch performs the morning tamid and the musafin, the incoming the afternoon tamid and the bazichin; four priests would enter there, two from this watch and two from that, and they divide the shewbread

בשלמא למאן דאמר משמרתו שוהה לבא, היינו דקנסינן לכולה משמרה; אלא למאן דאמר מרים בת בילגה שהמירה דתה, משום ברתיה קנסינן ליה לדידיה? -- the late-watch account explains penalizing the whole watch; but would we penalize him for his daughter?
אין, כדאמרי אינשי: שותא דינוקא בשוקא או דאבוה או דאימיה (= p_abaye_shuta)
Abaye: yes [we penalize him for his daughter], as people say: a child's talk in the market is either his father's or his mother's
ומשום אבוה ואימיה קנסינן לכולה משמרה? -- and because of her father and mother we penalize the whole watch?
Abaye: woe to the wicked, woe to his neighbour
Miriam bat Bilga, kicking the altar: 'lukos, lukos! until when will you consume Israel's wealth and not stand by them in their time of distress?'
some say: his watch was late in coming, and Yeshevav his brother entered with him and served in his place
